title: Yong
capsule: Yong (雍) was the largest of the 'Three Qins,' created in 206 BCE when Xiang Yu awarded the former Qin general Zhang Han the Guanzhong heartland around Xianyang, with Zhang Han's own capital at Feiqiu in central Shaanxi. Installed to block Liu Bang's Han forces in Sichuan, Zhang Han instead faced a surprise Han invasion in 206–205 BCE masterminded by Han Xin, and after a prolonged siege at Feiqiu took his own life in 205 BCE. Yong was then absorbed directly into Han dynasty territory.
